thread:
morgan: Quick huddle: we need a tight battle-lab fieldpack for launch (post + webinar + SDR play). Deliverables: 1p battlecard, 3 SDR micro-hooks, 1-page SE appendix.
vince: Target opponents: major cloud AI platforms, LLM API vendors, and DIY infra vendors. Different framing per opponent.
anya: For cloud platforms framing idea: Managed convenience, unpredictable economics. CTA: predictable routing and cost controls.
morgan: Good. For APIs: Fast to prototype, hard to govern at scale. Emphasize rollout controls, model pinning, function calling fidelity.
felix: Infra vendors: You buy control, you also buy ops time. Lead with our Dedicated + Private options and turnkey defaults.
olivia: Need one solid metric for headline. Proposal: "Typical SAAS app: 30% lower inference spend at equivalent QA w/ caching + smart batching". Defendable?
vince: It's defendable for convo-like workloads and our bench. I'll attach the bench note.
anya: SDR micro-hooks (short, plain):
- "Ship prompts now, avoid a surprise bill later."
- "Keep latency tight when users flood in."
- "Reserve throughput with SLA-backed capacity."
Include quick followups: "Want a sample TCO?"
felix: Rebuttals per opponent (one-liners):
- Cloud: "Managed is easy until tail latency and cost spike. We give controls + fallbacks."
- APIs: "Start now, scale smart. Pin models and do canaries without re-engineering."
- Infra: "Skip the heavy lift. Dedicated or Private with KMS and audit logs."
morgan: SE appendix items: bench methodology, workload spec, quantization profile used, and the canary rollback script. Keep it 1 page.
vince: Webinar plan (40m): 8m narrative, 15m live bench + routing demo, 12m field QA, 5m CTA + next steps. Demo script will show a capacity spike and our auto-fallback.
anya: Ill draft the launch post angle: "Same API surface. Predictable economics. Production SLAs." Slight variant for social: "Predictable inference, fewer surprises."
felix: Procurement handles: include a quick table mapping commit tiers to throughput and an example procurement note for legal (data residency, KMS).
olivia: I'll create the SDR email subject lines and 3x short call openers.
cms-bot: Reminder  publish assets to CMS by 4955050000 or the release will be delayed.
morgan: Everyone tag edits in the draft doc by EOD tomorrow: https://redwood.internal/marketing/battle-lab-fieldpack (placeholder). Thanks team, let's keep claims tight and provable.
